summary.text: Adrian Tam represents House District 24 (Waikīkī) in the Hawaii House of Representatives and was first elected in 2020, to District 22.

paragraphs.text: Tam was born and raised in Honolulu, graduated from Kalani High School, and holds a bachelor's degree from Pennsylvania State University.
Before his election Tam became a licensed real estate agent, worked as a session hire at the state House in 2016, and worked for state Senator Stanley Chang from 2017 to 2020.
Tam is the founding House chair of the Legislative Equality Caucus.
